result.summary: Found 3 issues: a major image styling problem in the restaurant carousel and two minor layout/styling inconsistencies.

issues.description: The first card in the 'Fastest near you' section ('Green Bowl Poké') has an image with a solid square background that does not fill the rounded corners of the card container, unlike the other images in the row.
issues.suggestion: Use an image asset that fills the container or apply CSS (e.g., `object-fit: cover`) to ensure the image properly fills the card's rounded boundaries.

issues.description: The title 'Smash Bros Burgers' wraps to a second line, pushing its delivery price text down and causing it to misalign vertically with the prices on the adjacent cards in the 'Fastest near you' carousel.
issues.suggestion: Truncate long titles with an ellipsis, reduce the font size, or allow the cards to flex in height to ensure consistent alignment of the metadata below the images.

issues.description: The translucent geometric shapes in the green promotional banner overlap the white text for the coupon code ('Use code TALLINN3...'), slightly reducing readability and visual clarity.
issues.suggestion: Reduce the opacity of the background shapes, reposition them to avoid overlapping text, or increase the contrast of the text.
